properties.description: Presented data beats must match already accepted ordered prefixes, zero padding, truncation at eight bytes, and the required final-byte marker, independently of m_ready.
Presented status responses must correspond in order to completed accepted input frames and contain the exact original length, adjusted length, pad and truncate fields, independently of h_ready.
Blocked data and status responses must retain valid and all enabled payload fields through the following edge unless reset cancels them.
A synchronous reset edge clears both presented response valids and cancels all private outstanding inventories without clearing earlier alarms.
Meaningful accepted input observations and transfer controls must be known; accepted frames and outstanding inventories must remain within the contract and private scoreboard bounds.

Combinational final-marker check requires a qualifying ready-high idle tail of at least 32 edges and complete acceptance and draining of uncancelled input, data and status obligations; no additional clock edge is required.
